{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == '999,999.99'
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Remove QA orders
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH and completed status
filtered_data = data_clean[
    (data_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (data_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (data_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
n_total = filtered_data.shape[0]
n_converted = filtered_data['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total if n_total > 0 else 0

# Output results
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {qa_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Filtered data shape: {filtered_data.shape}")
print(f"Number converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Total: {n_total}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
